workflows.name: Create Landing Page
steps: System creates a new draft page with default theme

workflows.name: Edit Landing Page
steps: User selects a page from the list
Editor loads with existing sections and components
User can drag components from palette to canvas
User can select a component and edit its properties in the inspector
Changes are reflected in real-time preview

workflows.name: Customize Theme
steps: User selects a preset theme or creates a new one
Changes apply immediately to the page

workflows.name: Publish Landing Page
steps: If valid, page status changes to 'published'
Page becomes accessible via its slug

workflows.name: Export Landing Page
steps: User downloads the code as a zip file
